summary: With the changes to the @facebook API I am hoping ethical news orgs like @ctmirror drop the use of the comment plug-in which requires write access (though I am sure facebook let's it live). Instead non-profit news orgs should adopt the #indieweb and use webmentions to gather links from across the web.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: With the changes to the @facebook API I am hoping ethical news orgs like @ctmirror drop the use of the comment plug-in which requires write access (though I am sure facebook let's it live). Instead non-profit news orgs should adopt the #indieweb and use webmentions to gather links from across the web.
